title: Optical
description: A short paragraph about reading, set in a serif with a true optical-size axis. Pinch, ctrl-scroll or drag up and down to zoom it from caption size to display size around your finger, and the letters redraw themselves as they grow: at the smallest sizes the face is wide, sturdy and open, spaced loose; as it grows the contrast sharpens, the counters close up and the spacing tightens, so every size on the way is set as a typefounder would set it.
intent: From Underware's Zeitung Flex automatic optical size (https://underware.nl/fonts/zeitung/features/Flex/): the design follows the point size continuously. Here opsz tracks the rendered pixel size and tracking follows the house law, -0.043 x (size - 12) px, so the craft of sizing is shown as one continuous zoom.
